.github/workflows/ci.yml.text:
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
    tags: ['v*']
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
        bun: [1.3.13, 1.4.0, 1.4.2]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: ${{ matrix.bun }}
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: bun run check
      - run: bun run build
      - run: bun dist/bunko.js version
      - run: bun run test:bundled-smoke
      - name: Prepare candidate
        id: candidate
        run: |
          bun run release:prepare
          bun -e 'import p from "./package.json"; import { appendFileSync } from "node:fs"; appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT!, "version=v" + p.version + "\n");'
      - uses: ./
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.version }}
          distribution-directory: dist/release
          bun-version: ${{ matrix.bun }}
      - run: bunko version
      - name: Prepare local Action base
        run: bun -e 'import {baseLayout} from "./test/helpers.ts"; await baseLayout(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + "/action-base");'
      - uses: ./build
        id: action-build
        with:
          path: examples/hello
          base-layout: ${{ runner.temp }}/action-base
          push: 'false'
      - name: Check Action outputs
        env:
          ACTION_DIGEST: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.digest }}
          ACTION_IMAGES: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.images }}
          ACTION_LAYOUT: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.layout }}
        run: bun -e 'const images = JSON.parse(process.env.ACTION_IMAGES!); if (images.length !== 1 || images[0].digest !== process.env.ACTION_DIGEST || !await Bun.file(process.env.ACTION_LAYOUT + "/index.json").exists()) throw new Error("Invalid build Action outputs");'

  # The build Action's `cache: github` block can only be exercised by a real workflow. The cold job seeds a
  # sentinel into the managed cache before its build and must report a miss; the warm job must report an exact
  # hit on the identical key and find the sentinel, which proves cached bytes were restored, not just a key.
  action-cache-cold:
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Prepare candidate
        id: candidate
        run: |
          bun run release:prepare
          bun -e 'import p from "./package.json"; import { appendFileSync } from "node:fs"; appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT!, "version=v" + p.version + "\n");'
      - uses: ./
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.version }}
          distribution-directory: dist/release
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - name: Prepare local Action base
        run: bun -e 'import {baseLayout} from "./test/helpers.ts"; await baseLayout(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + "/action-base");'
      - name: Seed a sentinel into the managed cache
        run: |
          mkdir -p "$HOME/.cache/bunko"
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" > "$HOME/.cache/bunko/selftest-sentinel"
      - uses: ./build
        id: action-build
        with:
          path: examples/hello
          base-layout: ${{ runner.temp }}/action-base
          push: 'false'
          cache: github
          cache-key: bunko-selftest-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - name: Check the cold run reported an explicit miss
        env:
          ACTION_CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.cache-hit }}
          ACTION_CACHE_KEY: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.cache-key }}
          EXPECTED_CACHE_KEY: bunko-selftest-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          echo "cache hit: $ACTION_CACHE_HIT key: $ACTION_CACHE_KEY"
          [[ "$ACTION_CACHE_KEY" == "$EXPECTED_CACHE_KEY" ]]
          [[ "$ACTION_CACHE_HIT" == "false" ]]

  action-cache-warm:
    needs: action-cache-cold
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, macos-latest]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - name: Prepare candidate
        id: candidate
        run: |
          bun run release:prepare
          bun -e 'import p from "./package.json"; import { appendFileSync } from "node:fs"; appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT!, "version=v" + p.version + "\n");'
      - uses: ./
        with:
          version: ${{ steps.candidate.outputs.version }}
          distribution-directory: dist/release
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - name: Prepare local Action base
        run: bun -e 'import {baseLayout} from "./test/helpers.ts"; await baseLayout(process.env.RUNNER_TEMP + "/action-base");'
      - name: Confirm this runner starts without the managed cache
        run: test ! -e "$HOME/.cache/bunko/selftest-sentinel"
      - uses: ./build
        id: action-build
        with:
          path: examples/hello
          base-layout: ${{ runner.temp }}/action-base
          push: 'false'
          cache: github
          cache-key: bunko-selftest-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
      - name: Check the identical key was restored with its contents
        env:
          ACTION_CACHE_HIT: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.cache-hit }}
          ACTION_CACHE_KEY: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.cache-key }}
          ACTION_CACHE_MATCHED_KEY: ${{ steps.action-build.outputs.cache-matched-key }}
          EXPECTED_CACHE_KEY: bunko-selftest-${{ runner.os }}-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: |
          echo "cache hit: $ACTION_CACHE_HIT key: $ACTION_CACHE_KEY matched: $ACTION_CACHE_MATCHED_KEY"
          [[ "$ACTION_CACHE_KEY" == "$EXPECTED_CACHE_KEY" ]]
          [[ "$ACTION_CACHE_MATCHED_KEY" == "$EXPECTED_CACHE_KEY" ]]
          [[ "$ACTION_CACHE_HIT" == "true" ]]
          [[ "$(cat "$HOME/.cache/bunko/selftest-sentinel")" == "$GITHUB_RUN_ID/$GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT" ]]

  integration:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.13
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: bun run test:build-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:multiple-entrypoints
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:native-ca
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:asset-contexts
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:workspace-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:closure-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:resolve-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:compile-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:operations-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:runtime-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:ko-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:zstd-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:cache-distribution
      - run: bun run test:prune-smoke
      - name: Install checksum-verified cosign
        run: |
          curl --fail --location --retry 3 https://github.com/sigstore/cosign/releases/download/v3.1.3/cosign-linux-amd64 --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/cosign"
          echo "4629c757b7618056f8ddd7e2625ae9fdd94c0372a65049520bc7d9df9efc7f71  $RUNNER_TEMP/cosign" | sha256sum --check
          chmod 755 "$RUNNER_TEMP/cosign"
      - run: bun run test:signing-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_COSIGN_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/cosign
      - run: bun run test:metadata "$RUNNER_TEMP/metadata"
        env:
          BUNKO_COSIGN_PATH: ${{ runner.temp }}/cosign
      - run: bun run test:registry-local
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
          BUNKO_SMOKE_REPORT: ${{ runner.temp }}/registry-local.json
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        if: always()
        with:
          name: registry-local-report
          path: ${{ runner.temp }}/registry-local.json
          if-no-files-found: ignore

  application-validation:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.13
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: bun run build
      - run: bun run test:application-validation
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:application-validation
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
          BUNKO_SMOKE_MODE: source
      - run: bun run test:fonts
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64

  runtime-injection:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 15
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        bun: [1.3.13, 1.4.0, 1.4.2]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: ${{ matrix.bun }}
      - run: command -v gpgv
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: bun test test/runtime-injection.test.ts
      - run: bun run build
      - run: bun run test:compile-smoke
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:runtime-injection
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
      - run: bun run test:application-validation
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64
          BUNKO_SMOKE_INJECT: '1'

  telemetry:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.3.13
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: bun run build
      - run: bun run test:telemetry

  cli-container:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: bun run release:prepare
      - name: Build the candidate CLI container
        run: docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f container/Dockerfile --build-arg "BUNKO_VERSION=$(bun -p 'require("./package.json").version')" -t bunko.local/cli-candidate:amd64 .
      - run: bun scripts/validation/container-smoke.ts
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: linux/amd64

  musl-runtime:
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    timeout-minutes: 20
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-latest, ubuntu-24.04-arm]
        bun: [1.3.13, 1.4.0, 1.4.1, 1.4.2]
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: ${{ matrix.bun }}
      - run: command -v gpgv
      - run: bun install --frozen-lockfile --ignore-scripts
      - run: bun run build
      - run: bun run test:musl
        env:
          BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS: ${{ runner.arch == 'ARM64' && 'linux/arm64' || 'linux/amd64' }}

.github/workflows/container.yml.text:
name: CLI container

on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Published CLI release to package
        required: true
        default: v0.7.0

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: cli-container-publication
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  publish:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      contents: read
      packages: write
      id-token: write
      attestations: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - name: Select an immutable published release
        id: release
        env:
          SELECTED_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
        run: |
          test "$GITHUB_REF" = refs/heads/main
          bun -e 'import { releaseTag } from "./scripts/distribution.ts"; import {appendFileSync} from "node:fs"; const tag=releaseTag(process.env.SELECTED_VERSION!); appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT!, `tag=${tag}\nversion=${tag.slice(1)}\n`);'
      - name: Download and verify the CLI payload
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          mkdir -p dist/release
          gh release download "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --dir dist/release
          cd dist/release
          sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS
          if [ "$RELEASE_TAG" = v0.1.0-rc.3 ]; then
            echo 'c441e95a41bb063b5bc1716e33c3f27bfbe606e156a9c2e1e8baddaa23394464  SHA256SUMS' | sha256sum --check
            echo '09486aa233147f781fb2068335d6b02fc4e5359853f2445573a5dfa5f2deb3cd  bunko.js' | sha256sum --check
          else
            cd ../..
            bun scripts/verify-release.ts dist/release "$RELEASE_TAG"
          fi
      - uses: docker/setup-qemu-action@c7c53464625b32c7a7e944ae62b3e17d2b600130 # v3
      - uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@8d2750c68a42422c14e847fe6c8ac0403b4cbd6f # v3
      - uses: docker/login-action@c94ce9fb468520275223c153574b00df6fe4bcc9 # v3
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ github.token }}
      - name: Refuse replacement of a published version tag
        env:
          IMAGE_REFERENCE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}:${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          bun -e 'import {parseReference} from "./packages/oci/source.ts"; import {RegistryClient} from "./packages/oci/registry.ts"; const r=parseReference(process.env.IMAGE_REFERENCE!); const response=await new RegistryClient(r.registry).request(`/v2/${r.repository}/manifests/${r.reference}`, {method:"HEAD"}, [`repository:${r.repository}:pull,push`], [404]); if(response.status !== 404) throw new Error("Container version tag already exists; refusing replacement");'
      - name: Build a digest-addressed candidate once
        id: image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@10e90e3645eae34f1e60eeb005ba3a3d33f178e8 # v6
        with:
          context: .
          file: container/Dockerfile
          platforms: linux/amd64,linux/arm64
          build-args: |
            BUNKO_VERSION=${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
            BUNKO_REVISION=${{ github.sha }}
          outputs: type=image,name=ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }},push-by-digest=true,name-canonical=true,push=true
          provenance: mode=max
          sbom: true
      - name: Validate the candidate and its compiled application on both platforms
        env:
          BUNKO_CONTAINER_VERSION: ${{ steps.release.outputs.version }}
          BUNKO_CONTAINER_IMAGE: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}@${{ steps.image.outputs.digest }}
        run: |
          for arch in amd64 arm64; do
            docker pull --platform "linux/$arch" "$BUNKO_CONTAINER_IMAGE"
            BUNKO_SMOKE_PLATFORMS="linux/$arch" bun scripts/validation/container-smoke.ts
            # Classic Docker image stores cannot retain both platforms under one index digest.
            docker image rm "$BUNKO_CONTAINER_IMAGE"
          done
      - name: Attest the container index
        uses: actions/attest@1e69f48acb82d1966a394da916b4c1698aa569d6 # v4.2.2
        with:
          subject-name: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          subject-digest: ${{ steps.image.outputs.digest }}
          push-to-registry: true
      - name: Verify candidate provenance
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          IMAGE_DIGEST: ${{ steps.image.outputs.digest }}
        run: |
          gh attestation verify "oci://ghcr.io/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY@$IMAGE_DIGEST" \
            --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --signer-workflow "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/.github/workflows/container.yml" \
            --source-ref "$GITHUB_REF" --source-digest "$GITHUB_SHA" --deny-self-hosted-runners
      - name: Promote the verified index without rebuilding
        env:
          IMAGE_REPOSITORY: ghcr.io/${{ github.repository }}
          IMAGE_DIGEST: ${{ steps.image.outputs.digest }}
          RELEASE_TAG: ${{ steps.release.outputs.tag }}
        run: bun scripts/promote-container.ts "$IMAGE_REPOSITORY" "$IMAGE_DIGEST" "$RELEASE_TAG"

.github/workflows/npm.yml.text:
name: npm distribution

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - scripts/npm-package.ts
      - scripts/validation/npm-smoke.ts
      - scripts/distribution.ts
      - scripts/verify-release.ts
      - test/npm-package.test.ts
      - .github/workflows/npm.yml
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      version:
        description: Existing attested GitHub release to package
        required: true
        default: v0.7.0
      publish:
        description: Publish the verified tarball using npm trusted publishing
        type: boolean
        default: false

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: npm-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || 'publication' }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  prepare:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      version: ${{ steps.package.outputs.version }}
      tag: ${{ steps.package.outputs.tag }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7
        with:
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - name: Select a release from main history
        env:
          SELECTED_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version || 'v0.7.0' }}
        run: |
          bun -e 'import {releaseTag} from "./scripts/distribution.ts"; import {appendFileSync} from "node:fs"; appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_ENV!, "RELEASE_TAG="+releaseTag(process.env.SELECTED_VERSION!)+"\n");'
      - name: Verify the published release before executing it
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          source_commit=$(git rev-parse "$RELEASE_TAG^{commit}")
          git merge-base --is-ancestor "$source_commit" origin/main
          mkdir -p dist/release
          gh release download "$RELEASE_TAG" --repo sakajunquality/bunko --dir dist/release
          BUNKO_ATTESTATION_SOURCE_DIGEST="$source_commit" bun scripts/verify-release.ts dist/release "$RELEASE_TAG"
      - name: Package unchanged release bytes
        id: package
        run: |
          bun scripts/npm-package.ts dist/release dist/npm "$RELEASE_TAG"
          bun -e 'import {appendFileSync} from "node:fs"; const p=await Bun.file("dist/npm/package.json").json(); appendFileSync(process.env.GITHUB_OUTPUT!, "version="+p.version+"\ntag="+p.publishConfig.tag+"\n");'
      - name: Test the packed npm and bunx consumer
        run: bun scripts/validation/npm-smoke.ts dist/npm dist/npm-artifact
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@043fb46d1a93c77aae656e7c1c64a875d1fc6a0a # v7.0.1
        with:
          name: npm-candidate
          path: dist/npm-artifact/
          if-no-files-found: error

  publish:
    if: github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' && inputs.publish && github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
    needs: prepare
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    environment: npm
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: npm-candidate
          path: candidate
      - name: Check the npm client and candidate integrity
        run: |
          node --input-type=module -e 'import {execFileSync} from "node:child_process"; const [major,minor,patch]=execFileSync("npm",["--version"],{encoding:"utf8"}).trim().split(".").map(Number); if(!(major>11 || major===11 && (minor>5 || minor===5 && patch>=1))) throw new Error("npm >=11.5.1 is required");'
          node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync,readdirSync} from "node:fs"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; const p=JSON.parse(readFileSync("candidate/validation.json")); const files=readdirSync("candidate").filter(name=>name.endsWith(".tgz")); if(files.length!==1 || files[0]!==p.filename) throw new Error("Unexpected candidate tarball"); const digest="sha512-"+createHash("sha512").update(readFileSync("candidate/"+files[0])).digest("base64"); if(digest!==p.integrity) throw new Error("Candidate integrity mismatch");'
      - name: Publish the tested tarball with provenance
        env:
          NPM_DIST_TAG: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.tag }}
        run: |
          npm publish ./candidate/*.tgz --access public --tag "$NPM_DIST_TAG" --provenance --ignore-scripts

  verify-published:
    timeout-minutes: 15
    needs: [prepare, publish]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: oven-sh/setup-bun@0c5077e51419868618aeaa5fe8019c62421857d6 # v2.2.0
        with:
          bun-version: 1.4.2
      - uses: actions/setup-node@249970729cb0ef3589644e2896645e5dc5ba9c38 # v6
        with:
          node-version: '24'
          package-manager-cache: false
      - uses: actions/download-artifact@3e5f45b2cfb9172054b4087a40e8e0b5a5461e7c # v8.0.1
        with:
          name: npm-candidate
          path: candidate
      - name: Download and compare the exact published tarball
        env:
          PACKAGE_VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
          NPM_CONFIG_FETCH_TIMEOUT: '15000'
          NPM_CONFIG_FETCH_RETRIES: '0'
        run: |
          mkdir downloaded
          for attempt in $(seq 1 21); do
            if npm pack "@sakajunquality/bunko@$PACKAGE_VERSION" --ignore-scripts --json --pack-destination downloaded > downloaded/pack.json; then break; fi
            if [ "$attempt" = 21 ]; then exit 1; fi
            sleep 15
          done
          node --input-type=module -e 'import {readFileSync} from "node:fs"; import {createHash} from "node:crypto"; const expected=JSON.parse(readFileSync("candidate/validation.json")); const result=JSON.parse(readFileSync("downloaded/pack.json"))[0]; const actual="sha512-"+createHash("sha512").update(readFileSync("downloaded/"+result.filename)).digest("base64"); if(actual!==expected.integrity) throw new Error("Published tarball differs from tested candidate");'
      - name: Execute the published package in a clean consumer
        env:
          PACKAGE_VERSION: ${{ needs.prepare.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          mkdir consumer
          cd consumer
          npm install --ignore-scripts --no-audit --no-fund ../downloaded/*.tgz
          test "$(./node_modules/.bin/bunko version)" = "$PACKAGE_VERSION"
          mkdir ../bunx-consumer
          cd ../bunx-consumer
          test "$(bun x "@sakajunquality/bunko@$PACKAGE_VERSION" version)" = "$PACKAGE_VERSION"
